title: T. T. Brown apparatus left in the Eureka garage

tellings.quote:

plain: Some of the equipment built by Thomas Townsend Brown, an inventor of electrically powered devices whose work comes up in the subject as an approach to mastering gravity, is said to have sat for years in a garage in Eureka, California. A UFO researcher named Clas Svahn tells Michels he went there himself. He says a group called the Borderland Society, which had ties to Brown, still had some of Brown's apparatus in the garage, but he could not take it away with him. Svahn also points to Brown's patent for an "electrokinetic generator" and to a biography of Brown by Paul Schatzkin, The Man Who Mastered Gravity.
